title: CBSE Class 11 Chemistry Named Reactions Notes Website (Handwritten Notes + Homepage Credit)

requirements.text: Create a homepage/front page that prominently displays the exact text: "made by PIYUSH SRIVASTAVA".

quotes: create a website in which handwritten notes on named reactions from chemistry class 11 cbse is there and front page will be "made by PIYUSH SRIVASTAVA"

acceptanceCriteria: Visiting the app root route shows the exact text "made by PIYUSH SRIVASTAVA" (matching capitalization and spelling).
The homepage provides clear navigation to the named reactions notes section.

requirements.text: Add a named reactions index page for CBSE Class 11 Chemistry that lists available named reactions and allows opening each reaction on its own separate page.

quotes: handwritten notes on named reactions from chemistry class 11 cbse is there

acceptanceCriteria: There is a dedicated page that lists named reactions.
Each reaction entry links to a dedicated reaction details page (separate page/route).

requirements.text: For each named reaction page, display the handwritten notes as one or more static images with basic viewing UX (responsive layout; click-to-open larger view or similar).

quotes: handwritten notes on named reactions from chemistry class 11 cbse is there

acceptanceCriteria: Each reaction page renders at least one handwritten-notes image from static assets.
Images are readable on both mobile and desktop (responsive scaling and sensible margins).
A user can view the notes at a larger size (e.g., open in a dialog/lightbox or dedicated full-view).

requirements.text: Apply a coherent visual theme across the site (colors, typography, spacing, and components) suitable for a Class 11 chemistry notes website, and keep it consistent across the homepage, index, and reaction pages.
acceptanceCriteria: A single consistent theme is used across all pages (typography, color palette, and layout).
Theme does not use a blue/purple primary look by default.

requirements.text: Add the generated handwritten-notes images and any decorative images as static frontend assets and render them directly from the frontend (do not fetch images from the backend).
acceptanceCriteria: All required generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the UI.
The app displays the generated images without any backend calls for image delivery.

constraints: Use English for all user-facing UI text in the app.
Frontend must not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose them instead.
Backend (if used) must remain a single Motoko actor; do not introduce multiple backend services.
Do not add third-party authentication providers; only Internet Identity is supported (and is optional for this request).
nonGoals: Building an admin panel or authenticated upload workflow for adding new note images.
Adding real-time collaboration, chat, or commenting features.
Integrating external databases or third-party storage/CDNs for notes images.
